package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ManualReviewRepoPG implements repository.
type ManualReviewRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Save inserts or updates manual review.
func (r ManualReviewRepoPG) Save(ctx context.Context, review domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview) error {
	_, err := r.Pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_task_answer_review (id, student_task_answer_id, reviewer_id, checked_at, final_score, status, feedback)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)
ON CONFLICT (student_task_answer_id) DO UPDATE SET reviewer_id=EXCLUDED.reviewer_id, checked_at=EXCLUDED.checked_at, final_score=EXCLUDED.final_score, status=EXCLUDED.status, feedback=EXCLUDED.feedback`,
		review.ID, review.StudentTaskAnswerID, review.ReviewerID, review.CheckedAt, review.FinalScore, review.Status, review.Feedback)
	return err
}

// GetByAnswerID returns manual review.
func (r ManualReviewRepoPG) GetByAnswerID(ctx context.Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview, error) {
	row := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, student_task_answer_id, reviewer_id, checked_at, final_score, status, feedback FROM student_task_answer_review WHERE student_task_answer_id=$1`, answerID)
	var review domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview
	if err := row.Scan(&review.ID, &review.StudentTaskAnswerID, &review.ReviewerID, &review.CheckedAt, &review.FinalScore, &review.Status, &review.Feedback); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &review, nil
}

var _ repository.ManualReviewRepository = (*ManualReviewRepoPG)(nil)
